name: Temporary Residence as Pensionado

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a regular, permanent pension of at least 5 times the SMVM (minimum vital and mobile wage), paid by a government, international organization, or private company for services rendered abroad, confirmed by an official certification from the issuing entity.

evidence_required.document: Official pension certification from the issuing entity

sources.title: Dirección Nacional de Migraciones -- Obtener una residencia temporaria como pensionado: 5x SMVM minimum pension, 1-year duration, RaDEX process

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Argentina). Same 5x SMVM income multiple as ar_rentista_residence.json, but for pension income specifically rather than asset-based income -- the two are separate DGM service pages with distinct qualifying-source definitions, not variants of the same route, consistent with how this dataset treats equivalent rentista/pensionado pairs elsewhere (e.g. Dominican Republic, Costa Rica).
